capabilities.description: DEV/TEST ONLY — grants the hypothesi tauri-plugin-mcp-bridge its commands so the MCP bridge can drive the main window during UAT. Merged ONLY via `tauri dev --config` (pnpm dev:bridge); never present in a production `tauri build`. The plugin itself is #[cfg(debug_assertions)]-gated in lib.rs and bound to 127.0.0.1. Kept OUT of capabilities/default.json and bootstrap.json so the production capability surface is unchanged.
